entries.developer_comments: ~ Dialogue line 'success' in mission 'Fungus Among Us'
identity: Thank you.  I don't like killing people, but this time we had to.  Here, take this; its some of our internal money that we've started using.  You know those religious pamphlets shaped like bills people would leave?  These are some of those, couldn't stand 'em myself.
